title:
Transforms the feature flag for Hyperparameter Optimization to account for the {@link ModelTemplate}
being used in the Model Configuration Workflow, and the current hyperparameter value.

This transform expects a JSON object with the following properties:
hpoFeatureEnabled {Boolean} - Feature flag for Hyperparameter Optimization.
hpoConfigurable {Boolean} - (Optional) Indicates whether the current {@link ModelTemplate} is HPO configurable.
       If provided, an `"AND"` operation is performed with the `hpoFeatureEnabled` key.

Returns a json object containing the original input json and the `hpoFeatureEnabled` key transformed based on the given params.
If no optional parameters are provided, the original input json is returned, unmodified.
name: ModelConfigHyperparameterOptimizationFeatureFlagTransform
